The Apple FAST tridiagonal eigh (Householder panels, df64 bisection, twisted vectors, compact-WY back-transform) on IDENTICAL NVIDIA/AMD: every product-meets-add / division / sqrt through checks/numerics seams, fixed 256-slot block folds, rank-2k update as ONE OP_NT identical GEMM at k = 64, back-transform as three identical GEMMs; clustered-spectrum refusal falls back to the identical Jacobi (decided by T's bits). ols_r_trisolve.notes: lane ols-r-trisolve (ideas-dense-linalg F1): LinearRegression solves R x = c from the TSQR's R_aug in one one-block launch behind a rank gate on R's p2-equilibrated diagonal (min > eps32*d*max), computed and returned by Mojo; gate 0 keeps the Jacobi-SVD route. Bits: coefficients from the back-substitution (fixed 256-lane fold + halving tree, same on NV/AMD/host) instead of V diag(1/s) U^T c; r2 expected equal. Host column _mojolearn_x_decomp_host takes the same define.
